summary: Iteration 38: Tested Admin Timetable Drag-and-Drop Rescheduling feature. All 18 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified: Admin Timetable Manager page loads with year group selector, draggable entries, Undo button, and weekly grid. Teacher Dashboard shows weekly timetable widget (not compact).
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/academic/admin-timetable requires auth (401/403)
Backend: Teacher gets 403 on admin-timetable endpoint
Backend: GET /api/academic/admin-timetable without year_group returns all entries and year_groups list
Backend: GET /api/academic/admin-timetable?year_group=Year+10 returns filtered entries
Backend: Timetable entry structure has entry_id, year_group, day, start_time, end_time, subject
Backend: PUT /api/academic/timetable/{entry_id}/reschedule requires auth
Backend: Teacher gets 403 on reschedule endpoint
Backend: Reschedule validates day (rejects invalid day with 400)
Backend: Reschedule requires day and start_time (400 if missing)
Backend: Reschedule entry success - moves entry to new day/time
Backend: Reschedule nonexistent entry returns 404
Backend: PUT /api/academic/timetable/{entry_id}/swap requires auth
Backend: Teacher gets 403 on swap endpoint
Backend: Swap requires target_entry_id (400 if missing)
Backend: Swap entries success - exchanges day/time between two entries
Backend: Swap with nonexistent target returns 404
Backend: GET /api/academic/my-timetable requires auth
Backend: Teacher can access my-timetable endpoint
Frontend: /admin/timetable page renders Timetable Manager with year group selector
Frontend: Year group selector shows Year 10 (and other year groups)
Frontend: Undo button present and disabled when no changes made
Frontend: Admin timetable table renders with Mon-Fri columns
Frontend: 50 draggable entries found with draggable='true' attribute
Frontend: Entries show subject name, time range, and year group
Frontend: Thursday highlighted as 'TODAY'
Frontend: Sidebar shows 'Timetable' nav item for SuperAdmin
Frontend: Clicking Timetable nav navigates to /admin/timetable
Frontend: Teacher Dashboard loads with TimetableWidget
Frontend: TimetableWidget shows 'Weekly Schedule' header (not compact)
Frontend: Weekly timetable table shows Mon-Fri with time slots
Frontend: Teacher sees their ICT classes in the timetable widget
critical_code_review_comments: Admin-timetable endpoint properly checks roles: SuperAdmin, Admin, CEO, Principal, HeadTeacher, HeadOfAcademics
Reschedule and swap endpoints require SuperAdmin, Admin, or HeadOfAcademics roles
Day validation correctly rejects invalid days (only Monday-Friday allowed)
Swap operation correctly exchanges day/time between two entries
Undo feature stores previous state in React state array
TimetableWidget on Teacher Dashboard shows full weekly view (not compact)
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
